notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Patch 1.1 fixes several minor issues reported during the first month after release.


 fixed: e2m1 glitch
 fixed: burning puppies
 fixed: Orloj repairing through the wall
 fixed: boss extra hp bug
 fixed: horse skull in the way (e1m8)
 Smaskou/Skapuci corpses no longer hold weapons
 fixed: pause menu during the intermission
 added missing subtitles

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.notes:
Changelog 0.2.6 - 0.2.8

https://i.ibb.co/RjXJpnS/update1-20.gif

NEW WEAPONS

 ball lightning launcher (secret experimental Soviet battery-powered weapon), sharing ammo with lightning gun, do not use underwater
 double barrel shotgun called BRNO (shares ammo with original shotgun and consumes 2 rounds as you expect)



GAMEPLAY

 new powerup: Calvaria of Čáslav - player deal double damage for 30 sec
 improved sickle melee - faster and deal more damage
 SMG reload removed
 force pistol reload via weapon switch
 monsters drowning underwater (except Bečva and Head)
 blue soldier (Skapuci) doesn't shoot immediately after teleport in
 electric cabinet gives more ammo
 added electric cabinet into Endless map
 miner and pedro appear in Endless
 cheats disabled in Endless 


FIXES

 fixed pink glitch from evacuation elevator (Palace of Culture)
 removed all unkillable monsters that were out of maps
 turrets and helicopters no longer bleed



MISC

 splashing when monster falls into water
 bindings for weapons
 improved pistol and shotgun sounds (thx to SquidTheSid)
 improved Lightning Gun model
 pistol reload polishing
 level stat in top right corner (default=off)
 heartbeat can be turn off (default=on)
 spiders can be turn off (default=on; available only in main menu and change does not affect savegames)
 added console access through menu Options/Global 
 several new sounds 



Hope you will have some fun!

- Enjoy!


AND THANK YOU
for all your forum posts, streams, comments, Tweets, feedback, everything!
